name: (FIXES)Realistic Home Defense [ALPHA]
desc:
They're coming through the door. Or you are.

Play with bots while you wait!

DEFENDERS hold the house. INVADERS break in.
One life. Three minutes. Last team standing wins.

- Realistic guns that shoot through thin walls
- Earn cash every round and buy rifles, silencers and grenades
- Up to 8 v 8 on Maple Street
- Warm up on the shooting range between rounds

Shut the doors. Check your corners. Good luck.
